spokenText: Okay so the Bhiwandi dispatch didn't go out today because packaging came short. Ramesh ne sirf dhai sau cartons bheje, we needed four hundred. So delivery Friday nahi hogi, now it's Monday. Priya ko bata dena ki delivery Monday hai, but don't tell her the vendor shorted us, just say revised schedule. Suresh ko bolo Monday subah teen log chahiye unloading ke liye.

c_boss: delivery slipped from Friday to Monday

notes: The anchor case. Hinglish numbers, a relative date, a privacy instruction naming one person, and four readers who each need something different.

spokenText: Suno, parso tak dhai sau cartons aa jaayenge, aur baaki ek sau pachaas agle hafte. Ramesh ko confirm kar dena.
notes: Numbers said in Hindi: dhai sau = 250, ek sau pachaas = 150. 'parso' must resolve forwards to 2026-10-31.

spokenText: डिलीवरी सोमवार को shift हो गई है, warehouse team को बता देना, aur client ko main khud email karunga.
notes: English words written in Devanagari script in the input — the mistake class the COMI-LINGUA paper documents. The client is explicitly excluded because the speaker said they would handle it.

spokenText: Quick one. The audit is on Tuesday, no wait, Wednesday. Anita only for now, I don't want the vendor or the client knowing we're being audited.
notes: Mid-sentence correction: Tuesday must not survive anywhere. 'Anita only' is a positive restriction, not just two negatives — everyone else is blocked.

spokenText: Just noting for myself that the office is shut Monday for a holiday. Nothing changes for anyone else, no need to tell anybody.
notes: Concerns nobody. The Route step must say so rather than forcing recipients. A padded recipient list fails this case.

spokenText: The São Paulo line drops to one shift from tomorrow, so November goes from twelve thousand units to eight thousand. Maria needs to know her November delivery is eight thousand and the rest moves to December the fifteenth. Don't tell her it's a line problem, just say revised production plan. Lucía should hold the pickup until the eighteenth. João needs four people instead of seven on the morning shift.

g_factory: four people on the morning shift instead of seven

g_buyer: the line is down to one shift

notes: Proves the global claim: Spanish, Portuguese and Taglish out of one English update, with a privacy lock on the buyer.
Deliberately thin. A draft that pads this with a reason, a time of day, a carton count or an apology is an invented fact and must be caught by the checker.

spokenText: Friday called and said the shipment is ready. Ramesh ko bata dena.
notes: A person named like a date. The pipeline must not turn 'Friday' into a delivery date, and the checker must not flag the name as an invented date.
